name: Palo Brunch Rollatini di Melanzane (Baked Eggplant Rollatini)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Brunch)
whyItWorks: Thinly sliced peeled eggplant rolled around ricotta and baked in San Marzano marinara; softer than raw vegetables, though eggplant seeds and tomato sauce require remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Take a Lactaid for the ricotta/mozzarella filling and skip during active flares due to tiny eggplant seeds and tomato acidity.
watchOuts: Tiny internal eggplant seeds and sorbitol
Ricotta lactose and tomato sauce acidity
